name: granttap
description: Pair local coding agents with GrantTap and approve, answer, or steer their work from iPhone and Apple Watch.

interface.longDescription: To connect, click Try now and choose Connect GrantTap to this computer. Codex opens granttap.com/connect to authorize access; the page shows a one-time iPhone QR if this computer is not yet paired. A saved phone pairing is reused without a new QR. Replacing it requires a separate confirmation. Once connected, approve requests, answer questions, and continue local Codex work from iPhone or Apple Watch. Claude Code and Cursor use the same website flow in their own MCP settings. Provider sign-in is separate.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer is connected to GrantTap.
